authority.rule: A v2/v2.1 FAIL, DEFER or veto rolls back only candidate delta and cannot revoke Step001-009 or Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS.

DECIDED: Gearbox v1 VERIFIED_PASS is the immutable fallback baseline; v2/v2.1 candidate FAIL/DEFER/veto cannot overturn it.

Secretary is sensor-only/nonformal. A stale secretary signal has zero gear effect; when fresh authority conflicts, secretary influence is invalidated and the actual fresh authority-required safe state must win.
Anti-thrash may block only nonessential upshift. Risk/recovery/safety downshift must bypass anti-thrash immediately; no cooldown, hysteresis or shift-rate gate may delay it.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake and window age are zero Experience. task last_run is not progress. P_base remains read-only unchanged.
Speedup evidence may use only paired matched-workload metrics. Window age, awake time, heartbeat count, commit count alone, poll/retry count and task last_run are forbidden proxy evidence.
Pressure/gear numeric thresholds and 5/4/3/1 credit weights are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance or promotion evidence.
Verified and operational credit must converge on one authoritative accepted-receipt path; receipt-less decision calls create zero new credit.
TEST_REQUIRED: Run one exact-current/current-head runner that compiles current v1/v2/v2.1 controllers and executes v1 tests + v2 tests + v2.1 tests together. Historical 21+16+12=49 PASS is support only until a fresh same-runner PASS exists.
Obtain a fresh dedicated W03/Spirit Gearbox v2.1 adversarial review. The latest W03 receipt is a general VALID_NO_OP and is stale relative to the current Gearbox v2.1 review cycle.

For Experience dedupe, verify exact replay=no-op, same evidence under new event_id=lineage duplicate, same event_id with changed evidence/kind/verifier binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT, and persistence across repeated calls, polling, restart and rollback.

Bind verified Experience to immutable evidence_hash/evidence identity plus provenance key/lineage, mission-step-scope, trusted verifier/C receipt, freshness/revocation and strict typed verification semantics.

Derive current_gear, verification_stage, secretary freshness/authority decision and anti-thrash shift rate from canonical trusted state rather than caller declarations; forged or stale values fail closed.

Anti-thrash requires trusted append-only shift history, minimum support/sample semantics, observation window, uncertainty and separate bounded enter/exit or equivalent stateful release; threshold jitter must not cause HOLD/RELEASE chatter.
Pressure/gear/predictive thresholds require a clean baseline plus incident replay and explicit false-positive, missed-warning and thrash statistics before tuning or adoption.

Speed validation must use paired matched workloads over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency, with verification/risk non-regression and uncertainty.

Paired speed protocol must precommit eligible-wake definition, exposure clock, start/stop, censoring, defer/reject/timeout handling and intention-to-treat assigned-workload coverage; use randomized AB/BA or crossover order from sealed matched snapshots with carryover controls.
BOUNDED_VETO: QV-GB21-FRESHNESS-AUTHORITY-001: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict remain caller supplied rather than replay-resistant evidence-bound inputs.
QV-GB21-AUTHORITY-CONFLICT-NO-AUTHORITY-SNAPSHOT-018: conflict handling neutralizes secretary but does not yet project/enforce the actual trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope safe state.
QV-GB21-VERIFIED-EVIDENCE-BINDING-002: independently_verified truthiness and missing exact evidence/verifier binding permit false verified credit.

QV-GB21-EVENT-REPLAY-FAMILY: invocation-local event_id dedupe cannot prevent same-evidence/new-ID, restart, rollback or poll reread inflation. event_id alone is insufficient; evidence_hash plus provenance/lineage and a rollback-resistant accepted-event registry are required.
QV-GB21-DUAL-CREDIT-BYPASS: select_gear_v2_1 can recompute credit directly from caller facts, bypassing a durable accepted-receipt authority.
QV-GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-STATE-BINDING-021: current_gear is caller supplied and can forge hysteresis/anti-thrash state.
QV-GB21-VERIFICATION-STAGE-AUTHORITY-BINDING-022: caller-supplied C_VERIFIED can remove the unverified cap without exact trusted C evidence.
QV-GB21-ANTI-THRASH-METRIC-BINDING-011: recent_shift_rate_ratio lacks canonical numerator/denominator, window, support and uncertainty binding.
QV-GB21-ANTI-THRASH-THRESHOLD-CHATTER-025: a single 0.50 gate without stateful enter/exit semantics can itself thrash near threshold.
QV-GB21-ANTI-THRASH-PERFORMANCE-005: anti-thrash can improve apparent shift rate while degrading closure throughput, cycle latency or recovery latency unless bounded and paired-tested.

QV-GB21-SPEEDUP-CLAIM-008 plus denominator/window/order/selection families: no adoptable paired speed claim exists until denominator, censoring, crossover/carryover and intention-to-treat controls are executable and tested.
Fresh dedicated W03 Gearbox v2.1 adversarial review is absent.
Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 same-runner regression PASS is absent.
